question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

The artist decided to use the ________(traditional) approach in creating a classic-style painting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Contemporary)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"traditional"** means something that adheres to established customs or long-standing practices. (पारंपरिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The traditional dress of the region reflects its rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **"Contemporary"** refers to something modern or current, often in contrast to traditional practices or styles. (आधुनिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's contemporary techniques brought a fresh perspective to the classic themes.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of "traditional" is "contemporary."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Contemporary)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unique** (अद्वितीय): Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.

 
 
• **Example:** Her unique style makes her paintings stand out from the rest.
 
 
 
• **Stale** (बासी): Something that is no longer fresh or appealing.
 
 
• **Example:** The bread had gone stale after being left out overnight.
 
 
 
• **Ancient** (प्राचीन): Something very old, often belonging to a distant past.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum houses ancient artifacts from centuries ago.
